title: Two Sum (Brute Force)
prompt:
Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to `target`.

**Approach:** Use nested loops to check every pair for O(n^2) time complexity.

**Requirements:**
1. Define and export `twoSum(nums: number[], target: number): number[]` in `solution.ts`
2. Use an outer `for` loop over each index `i`
3. Use an inner `for` loop over each index `j > i`
4. If `nums[i] + nums[j] === target`, return `[i, j]`

**Constraints:**
- Each input has exactly one solution
- You may not use the same element twice

**Examples:**
```typescript
twoSum([2, 7, 11, 15], 9)  // [0, 1]
twoSum([3, 2, 4], 6)       // [1, 2]
twoSum([3, 3], 6)          // [0, 1]
```

**Complexity:** O(n^2) time, O(1) space
hints: Start with two nested for loops
The outer loop picks the first element, the inner loop picks the second
The inner loop should start at i + 1 to avoid using the same element twice
Compare nums[i] + nums[j] against the target with ===

solution.ts.description: Export twoSum as a named export
Use nested for loops to check every pair
solution.ts.hint: The inner for loop should be inside the body of the outer for loop
